verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Rows 0 and 1 of `rowDensity` are literally R·U_n and R²·E_n, and `moments` integrates each over Ioi 0, i.e. ∫_0^∞, so m_{n,1} and m_{n,2} match exactly. The third moment differs in form only: the paper's integrand is ∂_RΠ_n, while Lean's row 2 is `pressureGradient n e omega R = (Σ_{i+j=n}E_iE_j − Ω_{n−1})/R`, the right-hand side of the radial momentum equation. The rewriting is the paper's own pressure equation Π'_n = 2C^{−2}φ_0φ_n + C^{−2}Σφ_iφ_{n−i} − Ω_{n−1}/(2X) (p. 47) multiplied by dX/dR = R and written in E via φ = C·E/R; `pressureGradient_eq_X_equation` is exactly that identity in Lean, for C ≠ 0 and R ≠ 0. So the Lean moment equals the paper's ∫_0^∞ ∂_RΠ_n dR wherever Π_n solves the radial equation, which is the only setting in which (5.10) is used.
